recentGenerations.prompt: Attempt to loft a circle to a rectangle; if profiles are too dissimilar, apply pruning rule to insert intermediate profile or fallback to multi-profile loft.
Create a carrot-like body with a mounting flange: revolve organic profile for body, add flange ring with 4 bolt holes in circular pattern.
Create an open-top electronics enclosure 4x3x1.5 inches with 0.1 inch walls using opShell after extrude. Expose wallThickness and openFace boolean.
Create a 90-degree elbow pipe with 0.5 inch outer radius and 2 inch bend radius using opSweep.
Create a transition from 2 inch square to 1 inch circle over 3 inches using opLoft. Expose height and profile offsets.

topMemory.title: Sketch Region Queries Must Use Sketch Id
Revolve Axis Must Be A Sketch Plane Line
Loft Profiles Must Be Topologically Similar
Parameters Must Be Exposed In Precondition
Organic Spline Control Points Must Stay Stable
Sweep Path Must Be A Connected Wire
Gear Prompts Must Expose Tooth Count Radius Face Width Bore And Pressure Angle

notes: generations stores raw prompts, extracted dimensions, output code, reasoning, and user feedback.
cad_memory stores scored CAD skill records used for retrieval, promotion, demotion, and pruning.
cad_generation_memory_matches links each generated result to the exact memories that influenced it.
cad_feedback_events turns copy/helpful/debug signals into quality-score updates for those memories.
cad_learning_state stores the trainable neural reranker weights.
If adaptive tables are missing, run supabase/migrations/20260505213000_adaptive_cad_memory.sql, then npm run seed:knowledge.
